notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
Improved game logic related to water detection
Walking forward and pushing stone while resetting the area will not cause the character to fall into the water
Fixed some other minor issues along the way

notes.title: UI Improvement Update
notes.content:
Tweaked some UI stuff to make it more aesthetically pleasing and also added some hints for the gamepad.

And…Happy new year my friends!

It’s a Spring Festival Update :)
